Name: Jehucal
Summary: Jehucal (also spelled Jucal), son of Shelemiah, was a prince whom Zedekiah twice sent to Jeremiah — once to ask him to pray for the city, and once among those demanding his death.
KeyStory: Zedekiah sent Jehucal to ask Jeremiah to pray to the Lord for them, yet Jehucal later joined the princes who said Jeremiah should die.
LifeLesson: The same messenger can carry a prayer request one day and a death sentence the next.
